sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 70. 3x to 6x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Curses for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Paralyzes for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK and MDEF by 60% for 80 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 20% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies beast (increases ATK and MATK by 60%; removes debuffs; removes status ailments; and applies a ward) for 60 seconds.
Dark Unison damage Ability Power boosted by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
